convention_rule: Four similar objects in a left-to-right row map to P1..P4 by ID order; the single green-lit/alive object marks the target.
basis: Rounds 2-4: the 3rd of four objects was green/lit in every image, revealed target P3 each time. Round 5: A shows the 4th planter alive under a green lamp; B shows the 4th birdhouse glowing green. Both point to position 4 = P4 (not client-correct P2).
